name: Lead Enrichment Pipeline
description: Takes raw leads (emails, LinkedIn URLs, or company names), enriches them with data from LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and stores the result in HubSpot CRM.

name: Abandoned Cart Recovery
description: Detects abandoned carts, triggers automated reminders via Gmail, WhatsApp, and Facebook Messenger, and logs interactions in HubSpot.

name: Competitor Monitoring
description: Tracks competitor websites, social media, and press releases. Alerts when a new product, campaign, or content piece is launched.

name: Reputation Management
description: Monitors brand mentions, collects reviews, and pushes summaries to Slack/CRM. Flags negative sentiment for fast response.

name: Upsell Trigger Engine
description: Detects when a customer purchases a product, and triggers an upsell/cross-sell workflow automatically.

name: Customer Success Alerts
description: Monitors usage metrics, churn signals, or support activity. Alerts Customer Success or auto-triggers retention workflows.

name: Automated Onboarding Flow
description: Kicks off onboarding sequence after signup, including welcome email, Slack invite, and task creation in project management tool.

name: Affiliate/Partner Tracking
description: Captures affiliate traffic, logs conversions, and updates dashboards or payouts automatically.

name: Proactive Outreach Sequencer
description: Runs multi-channel outreach sequences via Gmail, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, and Facebook Messenger with A/B tested messaging, logging responses in HubSpot.

name: Content Repurposing Engine
description: Takes a single piece of content (blog, video, podcast) and auto-generates multiple formats for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and email campaigns.

name: AI-Powered Support Escalation
description: Routes support tickets to the right agent. Escalates urgent issues via WhatsApp, Messenger, and Gmail, updates HubSpot CRM.

name: Finance & Cash Flow Alerts
description: Monitors bank accounts, invoices, and cash flow. Sends proactive alerts when thresholds are breached.
